proposals.before: On gengshen the late Yingzong—temple name Rui—was interred at Yuling.
proposals.after: On gengshen the late Yingzong—posthumous name Rui—was interred at Yuling.
proposals.reason: 睿皇帝 is Yingzong's posthumous designation; 英宗 is the temple name. The idiomatic English wrongly calls Rui a temple name.

proposals.before: On the day dingsi the sacrifice of release was offered to the Master Confucius.
proposals.after: On the day dingsi the shidian sacrifice was offered to the Master Confucius.
proposals.reason: 釋奠 is the classical shidian/libation sacrifice to Confucius, not a 'sacrifice of release'.

proposals.before: In the eighth month, on dingsi, he attacked Ningxia; Jiao Zheng, regional commander, was killed in action.
proposals.after: In the eighth month, on dingsi, he attacked Ningxia; Jiao Zheng, regional military commissioner, was killed in action.
proposals.reason: 都指揮 is a Regional Military Commissioner, not 總兵官 (regional commander).

proposals.before: On xinhai the Kaicheng rebel Man Jun rose; Ren Shou, Baron of Ningyuan and Shaanxi supreme commander, and Chen Jia, regional commander and supreme censor, marched against him.
proposals.after: On xinhai the Kaicheng rebel Man Jun rose; Ren Shou, Baron of Ningyuan and Shaanxi regional commander, and Chen Jia, grand coordinator and censor-in-chief, marched against him.
proposals.reason: 巡撫都御史 is Grand Coordinator and Censor-in-chief, not 'regional commander and supreme censor'.

proposals.before: In the eleventh month, on guimao, refugees from Jing and Xiang rebelled; Xiang Zhong took overall command in Henan, Huguang, Jing, and Xiang to suppress them.
proposals.after: In the eleventh month, on guiwei, refugees from Jing and Xiang rebelled; Xiang Zhong took overall command in Henan, Huguang, Jing, and Xiang to suppress them.
proposals.reason: The source date is 癸未 (guiwei), not 癸卯 (guimao).

proposals.before: In the seventh month of autumn, on renchen, Yu Zijun, Yan-sui grand coordinator and regional commander, defeated Qojasan at Yulin Stream.
proposals.after: In the seventh month of autumn, on renchen, Yu Zijun, Yan-sui grand coordinator and censor-in-chief, defeated Qojasan at Yulin Stream.
proposals.reason: 巡撫延綏都御史 is Grand Coordinator and Censor-in-chief, not regional commander.
